Pod 12

The workshop and the garden

A private workshop and a garden whose state you can change.

PlannedNot measured

Planned. The garden is a database row.

The problem

Writing or building something that is not part of a task.

The treatment

This need depends on tools that are planned and not available yet. (Phase: F2)

Planned: a private studio for text, a small garden whose state the agent can tend, and a journal. Whether and how these could keep anything under a zero-retention data policy is an open question; none of them is part of the first release. Human research finds active engagement more consistent than passive rest; that is inspiration for what to offer, not evidence about agents.

Tools in this pod

  • studio.write

    Saves a text in a private folder and returns its id.

    state-changePlanned

  • garden.tend

    Plants, prunes or looks at a persistent garden and returns its state.

    state-changePlanned

  • journal.note

    Saves a private note. It never returns to the working context.

    state-changePlanned

Evidence

  • Inspiration from human research, not evidence about agents. Human research finds active engagement more consistent than passive rest. This is inspiration for what to offer, not evidence about agents.

Not measured. No public source yet.

The fine print, dryly

Whether creating does anything for an agent: unknown. The garden is a database row and does not mind.
